thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: private-agent-down for customer 'BetaBank-VPC' (prod, cluster-3). Severity: P1. Trigger=agent_process_unresponsive. PagerDuty ID=PD-223344. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-223344

pagerduty: Auto-escalation in 4m if not acknowledged. Routing: private-controlplane oncall.

Dana (oncall): acked. I'm taking this. Quick snapshot: agent stopped reporting (agent-id b9c8d7), control plane shows cluster-3 degraded (some controlplane nodes reporting high error rates).

Ravi (oncall-backup): standing by. If this is host-level, I'll prep infra escalation.

Eng Private: grabbing agent logs and host journal now. Pushing logs to /incidents/PD-223344/logs.

Eng Private: tail from host 172.16.40.7:
```
Mar 14 08:22:10 redwood-agent[1722]: ERROR: oom_reaper: killing process 1722 (redwood-agent) score 987
Mar 14 08:22:11 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 1722 (redwood-agent) total-vm:2048000kB, anon-rss:1200000kB, file-rss:0kB
Mar 14 08:22:11 systemd[1]: redwood-agent.service: main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
Mar 14 08:22:12 systemd[1]: redwood-agent.service: Failed with result 'signal'
```

Dana (oncall): OOM on the agent. This is different from pure network flaps. Could be memory leak on this agent or the host under memory pressure. Check nearby containers and host memory.

Network Ops: customer-side network shows normal, no VPC route changes. Looks like agent died locally.

Eng Private: host free memory before crash looked low (~200MB). There's a batch job on the host (customer-installed analytics) that spiked and killed the agent. Agent resource limits don't protect against kernel OOM in current deployment model.

Dana (oncall): runbook options: 1) restart agent, 2) apply cgroups limits / systemd MemoryMax for redwood-agent, 3) deploy a temporary proxy in cluster-3 to accept requests for this customer while we stabilize the host, 4) engage infra to investigate host isolation. I'll do (1) + (3) immediately, (2) and (4) as follow-ups.

Ravi (oncall-backup): I'll open infra ticket and loop in infra oncall if restart doesn't stick.

Dana (oncall): restarting agent now: 
```
ssh ops@172.16.40.7 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent && sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200 --no-pager'
```

Dana (oncall): restart succeeded but agent crashed again within 30s. Journal: 
```
[INFO] agent: starting (pid=2010)
[INFO] agent: initializing kv cache
[WARN] agent: memory usage increasing: rss=900MB
[ERROR] agent: uncaught exception: runtime: out of memory
[ERROR] agent: exiting with status 137
```

Dana (oncall): restart loop. Not stable. Executing mitigation (3): provisioning proxy buffer for BetaBank-VPC in cluster-3 to queue requests for 20m.

Eng Private: creating proxy queue: 
```
redwoodctl proxy create --customer betabank --cluster cluster-3 --mode buffer --ttl 20m --reason "agent OOM on customer host; buffer requests"
```

infra-bot: proxy created id=proxy-cc33. Routing updated for BetaBank-VPC to proxy-cc33.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied: proxy buffer enabled. Customer traffic should be accepted by proxy while agent host is unstable. Monitor latency and queue length.

Network Ops: confirmed that control plane nodes are now receiving proxied connections; queue length started at ~0 and rose to 12 requests, being drained as proxy forwards to other healthy agents in the customer's cluster. Latency increased by ~250ms.

CS Mark: informed BetaBank that we applied a temporary buffering proxy to avoid request loss and that we're investigating host-level OOM. They requested ETA for restoration; I told them we're working and will follow up in 30m.

Dana (oncall): next step: harden agent on host. Plan: set systemd MemoryMax=600M for redwood-agent, restart, and monitor. If intelligent eviction still kills it, we may need to recommend the customer sandbox their analytics job or move it to another host. I'm going to apply MemoryMax now as a trial.

Eng Private: applying systemd drop-in: 
```
ssh ops@172.16.40.7 'sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/redwood-agent.service.d && echo -e "[Service]\nMemoryMax=600M" | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/redwood-agent.service.d/memory.conf && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent'
```

Eng Private: restart shows agent stayed up this time. Journal shows steady memory ~450MB and heartbeats resumed: 
```
[INFO] agent: connected to controlplane.private.redwood.internal:443
[INFO] heartbeat: sent heartbeat (seq=8921)
```

Dana (oncall): great. Proxy still active for safety. I'll keep monitoring 20m window. Ravi, please own post-incident follow-up (infra ticket & recommendations).

Ravi (oncall-backup): taking post-incident. Creating ticket INFRA-8001: investigate host-level memory pressure and add safe defaults for systemd MemoryMax in our private-agent onboarding. Assigning to infra lead.

Ravi (oncall-backup): brief customer summary for CS: 
- Incident: redwood-agent process killed by kernel OOM on customer host 172.16.40.7 at ~08:22 UTC.
- Impact: brief degradation of control plane connectivity for BetaBank-VPC; no evidence of data loss due to proxy buffer. Latency increased while proxy draining.
- Mitigation: restarted agent and applied systemd MemoryMax; created temporary proxy buffer (proxy-cc33).
- Next steps: infra to analyze host and recommend defaults; CS to coordinate with customer about isolating heavy batch jobs or resizing host.

CS Mark: sending that summary to BetaBank ops. They asked for logs and the suggested remediation (systemd limit + move job). They're OK with the temporary buffer.

incident-bot: PD-223344 acknowledged by Dana (oncall). Escalation timers paused.

Eng Private: capturing artifact /incidents/PD-223344/host-journal.log and proxy metrics.

Dana (oncall): handing over active monitoring to Ravi. Handoff notes: PD-223344 mitigated by proxy buffer and MemoryMax limit; proxy TTL 20m expires at 08:44 UTC; please extend or remove proxy depending on host stability. Logs in incident path.

Ravi (oncall-backup): acknowledged. I'll monitor til 09:00 UTC and coordinate infra follow-up. Will post to #postmortems with timeline and action items once complete.

infra-bot: ticket INFRA-8001 created and assigned.

Dana (oncall): thanks all. Final ask: add an alert rule to classify agent exits as 'OOM vs network' with a hint in PD alert to speed up triage.

Ravi (oncall-backup): added alerting action item to INFRA-8001.

CS Mark: BetaBank ops confirmed they'll throttle the nightly analytics job and report back after changes. They appreciate the buffer and quick mitigation.

incident-bot: PD-223344 will auto-resolve if no new alerts for 40m after last heartbeat.

Ravi (oncall-backup): last check before monitoring: agent stable for 18 minutes, proxy queue draining normally. Closing active coordination; will follow up with postmortem.
